STATE OF ILLINOIS
DEPARTMENT OF HUMAN SERVICES
SUPPLEMENTAL NUTRITION ASSISTANCE PROGRAM

NOTICE OF ACTION

Date of Notice: September 1, 2026
Case Number: SNAP-2026-00482

Dear Maria Johnson,

RE: Change in SNAP Benefits — Reduction

This notice is to inform you that your SNAP (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program) benefits will be reduced effective September 15, 2026.

REASON FOR ACTION:
Your household income has changed based on information received from your employer. Your verified monthly gross income has increased from $1,200.00 to $1,450.00. This change in income affects your benefit calculation under program eligibility guidelines.

BENEFIT CHANGE DETAILS:
  Previous monthly benefit amount: $352.00
  New monthly benefit amount:      $281.00
  Household size:                  3

YOUR RIGHT TO APPEAL:
You have the right to request a fair hearing if you disagree with this action. You may request a fair hearing within 90 days of the date of this notice. Your appeal deadline is November 30, 2026.

HOW TO REQUEST A HEARING:
To request a fair hearing, you may:
  - Write to: Illinois DHS, Bureau of Hearings, 100 S. Grand Ave., Springfield, IL 62762
  - Call: 1-800-435-0774 (TTY: 1-800-526-5812)
  - Visit your local DHS office in person

If you request a hearing before the effective date of this action, your benefits may continue at the current level until the hearing decision is made.

LANGUAGE ASSISTANCE:
If you need help understanding this notice in another language, please call 1-800-843-6154. Assistance is available in Spanish, Polish, Chinese, and other languages.

Si necesita ayuda para entender este aviso en español, llame al 1-800-843-6154.
